title: A failed Slurm record with application_started=false means LibRPA never started
symptom: Job 21836054 shows FAILED/0:53 and looks like a numerical failure; the real reason is 'incorrect nested WorkDir' at submission time.
root_cause: Scheduler records conflate submission-stage failures with application failures.
minimal_fix: Check application_started (and the earliest log lines) before diagnosing physics; fix the workdir layout and resubmit.
validation: Corrected job 21836121 completed and produced the strict-2D qavg numbers.
avoid: Burning debugging time on numerics for a job that never launched.
